description: This Java class 'DatatableData' is an immutable data object representing data tables with associated metadata, including table names, entity subtype, and column headers. It provides factory methods and accessors for its properties.

classes.name: DatatableData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing datatable data with attributes such as table names, entity subtype, and column headers. Provides factory creation method and column existence check.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a DatatableData object with specified attributes.

methods.name: hasColumn
methods.description: Checks whether the datatable contains a column with the given name.

methods.name: getRegisteredTableName
methods.description: Returns the registered table name associated with this data.
